executive_summary.headline: The builder layer is hardening around gates, memory, and MCP
executive_summary.body: Current repository activity is less about another prompt wrapper and more about workflow validation, database connectors, shared memory, orchestration, and tool policy. Those are the pieces that make agents operable.

executive_summary.headline: Security is shipping as an implementation detail
executive_summary.body: Argument-injection fixes, vulnerable-container removal, job dependencies, and scoped interfaces are practical signs that agent infrastructure is becoming production software.
